info.name: CONSTRUPRECO API
info.description:
Single collection: Auth + Dashboard (Supplier Inventory).

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}

Tests scripts auto-save collection variables after Login / catalog / inventory requests (accessToken, categoryId, inventoryProductId, …).

1) Auth → Login Supplier
2) Dashboard → Supplier → Inventory

request.description: Customer (user) email/password login.
Seeded via `pnpm seed:admin`. Default password from .env ADMIN_PASSWORD.
Customer signup. Returns requiresEmailVerification=true and sends OTP email (console if SMTP empty). Then call Auth/OTP/Verify before Login. Google/Facebook skips OTP.
Multipart form — documents optional for smoke test; required fields: companyName, email, phone, iban, password.
Public admin signup is DISABLED. Use `pnpm seed:admin` instead. This request is expected to fail with ValidationError.
5-digit OTP after customer/company email register (not Google/Facebook). Check email or server console if SMTP falls back.
Sends a 5-digit OTP to the email if an account exists. Same response whether or not the email is registered.
Validates the 5-digit reset OTP and returns a short-lived resetToken (10m). OTP is kept until reset-password.
Preferred after verify-reset-otp. Password min 8 chars.
Alternative: skip verify-reset-otp and send email + OTP + new password in one step.
Requires Authorization: Bearer <accessToken> from Login. Token payload includes role.
Returns root categories with Portuguese names.
totalProducts, totalStockValue, lowStockItems, outOfStock
Enter full SKU from inventory → autofills warehouse, category, subcategory, product type, title.

formdata.value: High quality Portland cement for construction.

request.description: Add Product — only when this SKU is not already PENDING/APPROVED. If already listed, use Edit Product (PATCH /api/products/:id).

formdata.value: High quality Portland cement for construction.

request.description: Edit listed product. Locked (not accepted): sku, categoryId, subCategoryId, productTypeId. Editable: title, prices, quantity, text fields, images, bulk. Goes back to PENDING_REVIEW.
Cancel PENDING listing → DRAFT and release listedQuantity. Then you can Add Product again for this SKU.

query.description: Optional — category name instead of id

request.description: Product list with tab + optional category filter (categoryId or category name)
Product detail page: title, rating, sku, category, warehouse, stock, price, bulkOptions, gallery, description/features/specs/reviews
Downloads demo CSV (UTF-8 with BOM). Columns category/subCategory/productType use text names from the Category Guide PDF.
PDF list of exact category → subcategory → product type names to copy into the CSV.

formdata.description: CSV file (max 100 rows). category/subCategory/productType = catalog names

request.description: Bulk Add Product from CSV. Images via URL columns: bannerImageUrl (1) + imageUrls (semicolon-separated). Server downloads them.
Resubmit REJECTED product. Same editable fields as Edit. Locked: sku, category, sub, type. → PENDING_REVIEW
Sponsored Product modal prices ($40/7d, $60/15d, $100/30d)
Confirm payment → promotion goes to admin PENDING_REVIEW
Scope (pick any combo): productIds | categoryIds (root) | subCategoryIds | productTypeIds. applicableUsers: ALL|CUSTOMER|COMPANY

query.description: all = every promo; product = only product-linked; catalog = category/sub/type only
